name: Barrel Launcher
source: Pathfinder #161: Belly of the Black Whale

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Integrated Launcher
defensiveAbilities.description: A projectile launcher is integrated into a clockwork assassin's systems, containing 10 spinning blades and five smoke bombs. When the assassin is destroyed, the launcher and its ammunition are also destroyed.

defensiveAbilities.name: Smoke Vision
defensiveAbilities.description: The clockwork assassin ignores the concealed condition from smoke.

defensiveAbilities.name: Wind-Up
defensiveAbilities.description: For the clockwork assassin to act, it must be wound with a unique key by another creature. This takes 1 minute. Once wound, it remains operational for 24 hours, after which time it becomes unaware of its surroundings and can't act until it's wound again.The assassin can enter standby mode as a 3-action activity. Its operational time doesn't decrease in standby, but it can sense its surroundings (with a -2 penalty to Perception). It can't act, with one exception: when it perceives a creature, it can exit standby as a reaction (rolling initiative if appropriate).A creature can attempt a DC 31 Thievery check to Disable a Device to wind the assassin down. For each success, the assassin loses 1 hour of operational time. This can be done even if the assassin is in standby mode.

offensiveAbilities.name: Poison Ink
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 38 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 10 rounds

Stage 1 3d6 Poison Damage damage and Sickened 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 4d6 Poison Damage damage and Sickened 2 (1 round).

offensiveAbilities.name: Rapid Repair
offensiveAbilities.description: The clockwork assassin spends 1 hour of its operational time to repair itself, regaining 25 Hit Points and refilling its integrated projectile launcher with 4 spinning blades (to a maximum of 10) and 2 smoke bombs (to a maximum of 5).

offensiveAbilities.name: Smoke Bomb Launcher
offensiveAbilities.description: The clockwork assassin launches a smoke bomb. A screen of thick, opaque smoke fills a 10ft Burst within 60 feet of the clockwork assassin. Creatures within the area are concealed, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong wind.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The clockwork assassin's Strikes deal an additional 3d6+4 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Unbalancing Blow
offensiveAbilities.description: Creatures hit by the clockwork assassin's rapier hand Strike are Off-Guard until the start of the clockwork assassin's next turn.
